summary: Cary Plastic Surgery · Cary, NC · 5 / 5 based upon 61 reviews.

body: Dr. Hanna is amazing! He is honest and makes sure you are completely comfortable with all aspects of the procedure. Never ever did I feel pressured. I highly recommend.
reviews.name: Jill Goodman

body: I had an amazing experience with Dr. Hanna from start to finish. He took the time to listen to my goals, answered all of my questions, and made me feel comfortable and confident throughout the entire process. The staff was friendly, professional, and always willing to help.

My results exceeded my expectations, and I couldn’t be happier. The attention to detail and level of care were outstanding, and I always felt like I was in great hands. I highly recommend this practice to anyone considering cosmetic or reconstructive procedures. Thank you for helping me feel more confident!
reviews.name: Heather Adams

body: Had two Pilar cysts removed from scalp by Dr. Hanna. I keep my head shaved and you can't even tell there's a scar there anymore from the wounds. Great price and great service.
reviews.name: Patrick Edgington

body: Dr Hanna and his team are amazing, I can't recommend them enough. I went to multiple consults but ultimately decided on Cary Plastics and I couldn't be happier. I really felt informed and that Dr Hanna and I had a shared goal from start to finish. The actual surgery and recovery were much easier than anticipated for my brest augmentation and abdominoplasty (all drainless with no complications).
reviews.name: Jessica Efferson

body: Great experience from consult through follow-up. Surgery was exceptionally easy -- breast reduction and mammoplasty, sedation (no anesthesia gas!!) and no drains post-op! Back to work in less than two weeks. Thank you Dr Hanna and team!!
reviews.name: BBarbital

body: Dr Hanna and his team helped me make my dream come true. After losing 125 lbs, I had a lot of skin on my stomach. There’s no way after being overweight for my whole life that it was going away. It had to be surgically removed. The results are mind blowing. I’m only 3 months out so I still have a very noticeable scar. It will fade. No one but my husband and I will ever see it in any event. I feel phenomenal! I am overjoyed at the wonderful care Dr Hanna and his team provided. I highly recommend Cary Plastic Surgery!
reviews.name: Connie Smith

body: Dr Hanna is the “best of the best”. He and his staff are very friendly and professional. He takes time to explain risks and rewards. I am very pleased with the process and the results. Highly recommend.
reviews.name: Fred Taylor

body: I can’t recommend Dr. Hanna and the team at Cary Plastic Surgery enough! After multiple consultations elsewhere, I finally felt heard during my visit with Dr. Hanna.

He took the time to thoroughly explain the mommy makeover process, ensuring I was comfortable and informed every step of the way. I had a mini tummy tuck and breast augmentation, and I couldn’t be happier with my results.
The staff and surgical team were amazing on the day of surgery, easing all my nerves. As a mom of two little ones, that meant so much to me. Dr. Hanna is truly exceptional!
reviews.name: Jess Owens

body: (Translated by Google) I had breast augmentation surgery and I'm extremely happy. Dr. Hanna is a highly skilled surgeon; for me, he's the best surgeon. From the moment I saw him, he instilled confidence in me. He's inspiring, and from the moment you speak with him, it's like having family. Talking to him, he clarifies all your doubts. Truly, my life changed from that day forward. God bless his hands and continue to give him wisdom. The eyes of the Lord watch over science. 👏

Me realice un aumento de senos Estoy sumamente feliz el doctor Hanna es un doctor con todas las potenciales como médico cirujano para mí es el mejor cirujano desde que me recibió me dio esa confianza eso inspira desde que hablas con el es como tener una familia tuya hablando contigo te aclara todas las dudas que puedes tener la verdad mi vida cambió desde ese día Dios bendiga sus manos y le sigas dando sabiduría los ojos de Jehova velan por la ciencia 👏
reviews.name: Miriam Franco Martínez

body: Dr Hannah and his Staff are very personable and knowledgeable. I could not have asked for better results I am so happy !!’
reviews.name: Patsy Earp

body: Dr. Hanna is THE BEST! He explains everything great and is very honest about all aspects of the procedures. I am VERY pleased with my surgery and with him and his staff. They are all so caring and professional. Also the follow up care is AMAZING. I just attended my 1 year follow up appointment to make sure all is well after a year. He schedules very regular check ups to make sure you are healing well and everything is good. This was very important to me! I would highly recommend him and would go back to Dr. Hanna for another procedure in future with no hesitation. :)
reviews.name: K Walls

body: Dr Hanna has been the NUMBER 1 CHOICE for all of my cosmetic surgery needs over the years. Most recently, Dr Hanna performed my face lift. The outcome was perfect . Completely natural and subtle results without complications. I get frequent compliments on how natural and “refreshed” I look after my facelift !

The entire experience when dealing with this office is exceptional. The staff is personable, accommodating to my scheduling needs and thorough! Dr Hanna is very approachable, personable, thorough in answering all questions, professional and caring . This is a plastic surgeon that I’ve come to TRUST, and THAT is truly very important when choosing the right doctor for your plastic surgery needs.
reviews.name: Marie Troxell

body: Dr. Hanna is an amazing doctor. I had 4 children via c-sections so to say I needed some help in my abs/tummy area is an understatement. I spent years working out trying to get my body back and it only goes so far when you have that much scar tissue built up.

Dr. Hanna came highly recommended from friends who had used him for other procedures and their results were amazing! Dr. Hanna spent so much time with me to answer all my husband's and my questions during the consult. I don't think I've felt more heard in a doctor's appointment before. He did not rush me and made me feel so comfortable and confident before my procedure.

I am now about 3.5 months post tummy tuck and my results are OUTSTANDING! I feel like myself again after years of feeling like I wasn't me. And you know you look good when you go to your annual gyn appointment and my gyn asks me who did my procedure because she has not seen results that great before!
Dr. Hanna's staff is so helpful and he and his whole team are super supportive of their patients. I absolutely 100% recommend him!
My only regret? ...I didn't call him to have this procedure done sooner!
reviews.name: M Johnson

body: Dr. Hanna is amazing. I have been wanting a breast augmentation for a very long time but didn't have a clue what size I wanted. I went in for my consultation and he helped me pick the best size for my body. I had my surgery 3 months after my consultation and let me just say I AM IN LOVE. He listened to every concern I had and he went above and beyond to make sure I was happy with my results. I will definitely be referring Dr. Hanna to others!
reviews.name: Tyler Veasey

body: Dr. Hannah and his staff are simply wonderful! I am a year post op and he took such good care of me the whole time. My results exceeded my expectations!! He is a very gifted surgeon who really cared about me and my comfort and results. 100% recommend Cary Plastic Surgery and Dr Hannah!!!
reviews.name: wendy arnold

body: I first met Dr. Hanna 23 years ago. He has performed surgical procedures on me and others in my family. I honestly cannot say enough good things about him. I also had procedures performed by him as recent as 4 months ago. I wish he could be my Dr. for everything! So kind and caring. His bedside manner is the best I have ever had in my 60 years. Never ever have I felt rushed through any of my appointments. He is punctual and I have never sat waiting in the waiting room past my appointment time. Every procedure he has done on me or my family members has been outstanding.
reviews.name: elizabeth jordan

body: I can honestly say that I have never written a review before. I knew about Dr. Hannah since working with a dermatology doctor 20 yrs ago. I had also seen work that he has done on many types of reconstructive surgeries!

But, lets get serious about the kindness and quality of work this surgeon can perform. There is nothing unknown before you lie on his table. His confidence in what he does makes him the best there is. Each patient is like a puzzle to him. I also like the fact that he is happy when his patients are happy. He is proud of his work, and that makes him an absolute gem!! All of the staff is impeccable. So, if you want to work with someone who is kind, accurate, and honest about what he can do, then you have found him!!
Thanks Dr. Hannah!
Leslie R.
reviews.name: Leslie Rinne

body: Dr. Hanna and staff are the BEST!! I had two procedures. Dr Hanna was very knowledgeable and provided the most up-to-date information regarding surgical procedures. I had never had plastic surgery and wasn't sure if I was a good candidate. I was well informed with all the details from beginning thru recovery. He and his staff were always helpful and the friendliest. I was completely satisfied with my results. I would not hesitate a return if ever needed. I highly recommend if considering plastic surgery - CONSULT with Dr Hanna!
reviews.name: Linda Rao

body: Dr. Hanna is amazing. Great work and awesome bedside manner. Love his sense of humor. And his staff is top notch!
reviews.name: Nadine Traughber

body: Dr. Hanna is an amazing plastic surgeon. He is extremely picky and a perfectionist, like myself. I wish I had my reduction/lift sooner. He far exceeded my very critical expectations, and I honestly feel like a new woman. I absolutely adore Dr. Hanna and will recommend him to anyone seeking an outstanding surgeon, with history and skill that far surpass his peers.
reviews.name: Nicole Robertson

body: I Love Dr. Hanna ! He has such a great bedside manner. He is extremely patient and takes time to explain and answer any questions waiting family members may have.
reviews.name: Lorie

body: Dr. Hanna and all of his staff are super kind, considerate And compassionate. He takes the time to explain and inform. Very happy with my results, highly recommend!
reviews.name: Tamara Miller

body: Dr. Hanna and his staff are and have been amazing. I can’t say enough about Dr. Hanna. He made no promises about my results and discussed the entire procedure with me several times. It’s only been 3 months and am so happy with my results. I’m amazed at how quickly I’ve healed and the scaring is barely visible. I am so thankful to have found him.
reviews.name: Shanique Rano

body: Dr. Hanna is amazing!! For years I've been wanting breast augmentation and after many consultations, I felt the most confident with him. He took the time to explain everything, was honest and listened to what I wanted. Most importantly, he suggested what was going to be the best for me. My breast look amazing, natural and they are the perfect size for my body composition. Look no further if you want a pair of tatas!
reviews.name: Bernice Lopes

body: Dr. Hanna is the best. Gives you honest feedback on what you need and what you don't need and I have always come out of there happy.
reviews.name: Jessica Gambill

body: Dr. Hanna and his staff were very informative, prompt, and professional. Dr. Hanna's bedside manners were impeccable.
reviews.name: Kelly Finemore

body: If you are considering plastic surgery- Dr Hanna should be your first call for consultation! Dr. Hanna is a kind and compassionate person - NOT to mention an EXTRAORDINARY surgeon!! He will share all the information for your procedure while making your feel as ease. My breast procedure was daunting for me at first. Dr. Hanna answered all my questions and made me feel as though I was his ONLY patient. I could not be happier with the outcome and would highly recommend his services!! His staff is amazing!! Jessica is awesome- she took time to help me with all the paper work.
reviews.name: Linda Rao

body: Great experience. Love Dr. Hanna. He has wonderful staff helping to enhance the experience. Thanks for making me better!
reviews.name: Cindy Force

body: Dr. Hannah is a great doctor! I went for a breast reduction and I am really pleased with the outcome of it. I totally recommend Dr. Hannah.
reviews.name: Yazmin Estrada

body: Great experience. Dr Hanna is the best. Highly recommend this practice.
reviews.name: Debbie Stackhouse

body: Dr. Hannah is wonderful. He is kind, up front, honest about potential results and his bedside manner is amazing. He will never try to oversell you and has so much experience knowing what will be right for someone's body. I was skeptical of some of the things he said at first but boy am I happy that I listened to him, my results were better than my wildest dreams. I am so happy and confident in how I look and feel in a way I never was before. Cannot recommend enough.
reviews.name: Hannah Barnes

body: I think Dr. Hanna is an extraordinary surgeon. His skills are excellent! I left the decisions regarding my breast reduction up to him, and I could not be happier with the results. Both he and his staff are very kind and compassionate...truly exceptional! If you are contemplating surgery, I hope you will consider him. I am thrilled to have landed in Dr. Hanna's office; he's simply outstanding!
reviews.name: Sally Mcgowan

body: If you are considering any kind of plastic surgery, please let Dr. Donald Hanna perform your surgery! He is wonderful! Dr. Hanna really cares for the patient and is very dedicated to his patients!! I recently had surgery and was scared to death. He put me at ease, and I know Dr. Hanna is Heaven-sent! He has 30+ years of experience and knows what is best for you! I cannot say enough nice things about him. His staff is just as wonderful. One of his staff named Jessica is like a ray of sunshine every time you go to visit his office. I am one of Dr. Hanna's biggest fans!
reviews.name: Jill Phipps

body: I have always had a problem with extra bra line skin. Dr. Hanna came highly recommended to me & to say he has changed my self image & my ability to look at myself without disgust is an understatement. I look so good & feel so happy. Dr. Hanna has a bedside manner that makes you so comfortable, you feel like hes an old friend. Thank you Dr. Hanna for changing my life. I also want to add that his entire staff is wonderful!! If you are struggling with something on your body do yourself a favor & visit Dr. Hanna.😁
reviews.name: Marilyn Henry

body: He has been my surgeon since 1988. I was a 25 year old that just had a mastectomy. He performed the reconstruction and he performed the subq and reconstruction on the other side. He was amazing and still is. I highly recommend him!
reviews.name: Kristal Kelley

body: If you are hesitating on scheduling an appointment/consultation, don't! Dr. Hanna is a gem - he is knowledgeable, thorough, incredibly kind and candid. The office staff are great as well. I left my visit with so much more information and direction than I came in with. Highly recommend.
reviews.name: Katie Burke

body: Dr. Hanna is amazing. He is kind, compassionate and completely dedicated to quality of care. He is extremely respectful but also upfront and honest. He has truly changed my life and I am so greatful to him. His staff is warm and welcoming and goes above and beyond to make your experience positive. His anesthesiologist was amazing. She went above and beyond to make sure I was comfortable and didn't feel a thing. Thank you all for respecting my needs, fears and transformation.
reviews.name: Glitter Rat

body: EXCELLENT. I wanted a couple of moles and skin tags removed from my face without leaving scars. I was very difficult to schedule a dermatologist, but my primary care Dr. stated that a plastic surgeon would be much better because dermatologists are not necessarily concerned with scars, and he was 100% correct! Dr. Hana performed this mid Dec.2018 and there is no way to tell they were there. No scar, no trace! Also, Dr. Hana was less expensive, and MUCH easier to deal with. I can't recommend him and his staff enough. Thank you!
reviews.name: R C

body: Dr. Hanna, thank you for an excellent job! You have the best staff too!
reviews.name: Lynn Gardner

body: I will always recommend Dr. Hanna to anyone. I had a breast reduction and I went from a G to a small D. He did a great job and I would do the process all over again if I had to! He’s an artist! He was very patient and answered all my questions. The front staff, especially Elouise, was very helpful with the process of insurance covering the surgery.
reviews.name: Courtney Phillips

body: I am proud to recommend Dr Hanna at Cary plastic surgery as who I believe is the best on what he does. I recently had a tummy tuck and a breast lift done by Dr Hanna. He sat down with my husband and I and explained to us step by step the entire procedure. It was easier to make a decision after seem his knowledge, and professionalism. I don't have enough words to express my satisfaction. He is patience, passionate, experienced and showed his talent on me. I feel amazing with the results! Thank you Dr. Donald Hanna!.
reviews.name: alexandra Aguilar

body: Beautiful and clean office with very peasant staff. Dr. Hanna spent a good amount of time giving me very informative advices without trying to get me into any procedures, and even talking me out of some, explaining his professional reasons. I have learned about the options for my case that didn't involve his office. He was caring and genuine that made my visit just that much more special.
reviews.name: Galina Spencer

body: My wife has had two surgeries performed by Dr Hanna. She and I both are more than pleased with his work. He takes his time with his patients and listens to all their concerns & questions. He is very professional and has an amazing bed-side manner. Would recommend him highly.
reviews.name: Conn Harrington

body: Cary Plastic Surgery is wonderful with 5+ star rating from me and my husband! I’ve known Dr. Hanna since 1992/3 when my youngest son had an injury to his nose bridge, incredible experience for my son and for me! Totally impressed with his skills. My son Michael has no scar and a happy memory.

I needed to have eye lid surgery and the entire experience was the best experience I have ever had with any Doctor in my life! Dr. Hanna is one of a kind in his profession. His entire staff, from office to the entire surgical staff was so professional, caring and very patient orientated! I never thought twice about being in great hands by the entire surgical staff and of course Dr. Hanna! A beautiful job was done for me!!!!

My surgery was in early August and “smooth and satisfactory” doesn’t do justice. PERFECTION in every way...can’t wait to have my 6 month visit and take the after photos. I’m proud to have Dr. Hanna as my surgeon and I recommend his practice very very highly!!! My husband and my sons have the same opinions. Thank you to Dr. Hanna and your entire staff!!!!! You are an incredible Plastic Surgeon,
and you have a great personality, a VERY beautiful quality.
Thank You,
Dianne Calloway
reviews.name: Dianne Calloway

body: I went for a consultant and was very happy to have met with Dr. Hanna. He was very honest, concerned and truthful above all. I will have my surgery as soon as I'm ready hopefully by May 2018 for Breast reduction.
Sincerely,
Millie😍
reviews.name: Milagros Erazo

body: Dr. Hanna and his staff are the best. Had eyelid surgery and could not be happier with the results. Dr. Hanna was recommended to me and I am so glad I had him perform the surgery.
reviews.name: Mary Carol Ruppen

body: Dr Hanna did my eyelids surgery and I couldn't be happier. I have not let anyone take my picture for 5 years and now I want my picture taken to keep the memories. Amazing surgeon and experience, I can say enough about him. Also his office manager Eloise is super and knows her stuff!
reviews.name: Barbara Scheil

body: Wow!! Just Love Dr. Hanna's work! I had eyes done and a face lift! Within a week I put on full make up and went out with friends. I simply look 10 years younger, not fake. You don't look and think, gee, she had some work done...Just, wow, that looks Great! Results surpassed my expectations.
And btw, this surgery is not painful. Feels weird for a little while, that goes away😃
Dr Hanna's staff are all wonderful, happy, helpful people!
reviews.name: Chantel Chandler

body: Dr. Hanna performed my breast reduction last week. I am extremely pleased with the results. The surgery was done at Wake Med Cary Hospital. Every staff member was very friendly, knowledgeable and helpful. Dr. Hanna checked on me several times after surgery. He spoke with my family before they saw me in recovery. My family said his bedside manner was awesome. I have also been pleased at each office visit. Dr. Hanna always explained everything in great details. He never rushed me in answering my questions. He made sure I was pleased with the surgery. I would go back to Dr. Hanna again and again. The staff in his office are also very friendly and helpful.
reviews.name: Otissa Turner

body: I consider myself lucky to be in an area where there's such a talented & charismatic surgeon -- especially one whom is comfortable and experienced with performing cosmetic surgeries on African American women. I cried tears of joy when I saw myself post-op. I did have minor complications during the healing process, but it all had to deal with how my body healed .. nothing to do with Dr. Hannah's work. I was extremely anxious & concerned at first, but he promised it would heal just fine & everything went EXACTLY the way he said it would.. I'm so grateful for that. I'd recommend him to anyone.
reviews.name: Breanna Combs

body: I could not be more pleased with the care I received from Dr. Hanna and his staff. I had a procedure done by a plastic surgeon in another state and I was not at all pleased with the results. Dr. Hanna performed the same procedure and gave me the results I was looking for. I knew exactly what to expect before the surgery and the follow up care was phenomenal.
reviews.name: Carolyn Dammers

body: I had a breast augmentation done in April of 2016, and I am over the moon with my results! Dr Hanna, his office staff, and OR staff were great in helping me achieve the look I desired. There are a lot of different options for implants out there, and they helped me pick the perfect fit!! Highly recommended!
reviews.name: Samantha M

body: The search for a qualified plastic surgeon ended at Dr Hanna of Cary Plastic no matter who I asked. And everyone was right. Dr Hanna and his staff are personable and professional. He was candid about what procedure would be best for my desired result and honest about what the results would most likely be for me. I felt comfortable before, during and after my procedure. I will return for any future procedures.
reviews.name: K Sedivy

body: I've been going to Dr. Hanna for many years for various treatments from removing a mole on my face, correcting facial lacerations that were performed in the ER by another plastic surgeon, to Botox.

Dr. Hanna is very professional, thorough, and has always done a wonderful job. I have no scars on my face from my mole removal and I'm recovering very well from my facial lacerations that are only a month old.

I would also like to add that when you have an appointment with Dr. Hanna, he treats you as if you are his only patient, and he takes his time and thoroughly explains things. That's why if you have to wait to be seen in his office, it's well worth it!
Recently I had an emergency and was able to get into the office that same day.
In addition to Dr. Hanna, it's very important to me that his staff is not only professional, but also very accommodating.
Thank you Dr. Hanna & Staff
-JI
reviews.name: Jan Ivey

body: Choosing to maintain your youth or enhance your beauty Dr. Hanna is the ONLY DOCTOR for the job. Dr. Hanna listens, remembers who you are years later and shows a great bedside manor . His humor is calming and he truly cares for each patient . I have seen him a number of times for skin cancers and he has continued to be honest and supporting. I am always thrilled with his magic and will continue to return.

As the Raleigh and Cary area have grown we see many new plastic surgeons . They may be good but experience and years of dealing with all sorts of issues has kept Dr Hanna at the top. Before you make your final decision speak to an EXPERIENCED PLASTIC SURGEON DR. HANNA. You will get the best because he is the best .
reviews.name: Camille Monsma
